elements.element: The obligations apply upon either expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added clause applies “Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: Licensor, as Vendor, must provide transition assistance to Licensee, as Customer.
elements.evidence: Licensor must, at Licensee’s request, “provide transition assistance to Licensee.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six (6) months.
elements.evidence: The clause guarantees only a period of at least 90 days; it does not guarantee availability for six months.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Licensor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no pricing or rate provision for transition assistance.

elements.element: Licensor must return Customer Data to Licensee.
elements.evidence: Licensor must “export and deliver to Licensee” all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Licensee that is in Licensor’s possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The export and delivery obligation must be completed “within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: “Export and deliver” does not expressly require a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Licensor must delete Customer Data after returning it.
Licensor must certify deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: No deletion certification obligation is included.

elements.element: The obligations apply upon either expiry or termination of the Agreement.
elements.evidence: The added clause expressly applies upon “expiry or termination” for any reason.

elements.element: Licensor, as Vendor, must provide transition assistance to Licensee, as Customer.
elements.evidence: Licensor must provide transition assistance at Licensee’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least ninety (90) days.
elements.evidence: The clause requires transition assistance “for a period of at least ninety (90) days.”

elements.element: Licensor must export and deliver Customer Data to Licensee.
elements.evidence: The clause requires export and delivery of all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Licensee that is in Licensor’s possession or control.

elements.element: Customer Data must be exported and delivered within thirty (30) days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly imposes a thirty-day deadline measured from expiry or termination.

result.reason: The operative addition fully implements the fallback through at least 90 days of requested transition assistance and Customer Data export and delivery within 30 days. It does not satisfy the preferred position because it omits six-month availability, then-current rates, a standard machine-readable format, deletion, and certification of deletion. The amendment is narrowly directed to exit assistance and data return and does not contradict the existing return obligations, though the drafting leaves the scope and commercial terms of transition assistance undefined.
